notes.title: AvaKit Official Release!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.avakit.org/en][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/cd75cb6fbcef1c11c2c7365a65be124eb42e7812.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Conversion as a paid version [/h2]

First of all, thanks again for all of AvaKit users for using AvaKit.

From [b]30th April, 2024[/b] AvaKit will be converted as a [b]paid version[/b]. This decision is for developing more awesome features in AvaKit and improving entire services in AvaKit. After the conversion, we’ll do our best to provide the best services for all of you. (The paid version can be purchased in [url=https://www.avakit.org/en]the official AvaKit website[/url].)

You can get a [b]one-month free trial[/b] for the new AvaKit. During the trial period, you can use entire wonderful features that are newly developed based on several tests with various VTubers.

We look forward to your consistent interest and support for our service, and we will do our best to reward you with better features and services.

Thank you.

AvaKit dev team.

notes.title: [AvaKit Official Release] AvaKit v2.0.0 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/dcc46273d9f97395251ac5afa260d025d019adf1.png[/img]

[h2][b]AvaKit is back with much stronger and easier features![/b][/h2]
AvaKit update has stopped for more than 3 months. However, NEW AvaKit with OFFICIAL version comes back with much stronger and easier features and UI! On 13th Feb, official version is released.
Thank all of you for waiting for a long time.

[h3]«👀New AvaKit Summary»[/h3]
⓪ Real-time mo-cap for 3D avatars with just a single, common webcam💫
① Camera device detection improved & much smoother tracking 
② lilToon rendering support & Improved avatar rendering pipeline
③ Preset props & effects upgraded
④ Rotation in all directions available
⑤ VMC Protocol & Spout2 integration improved
⑥ User-friendly UI

[h3]«📝Announcement»[/h3]
Official version will be distributed from 13th Feb 19:00 to 15th Apr 12:00 (KST) with [b]FREE[/b], and this version will be converted into [i]paid[/i] version. (Free version will still remain, so don't worry!) Since the accurate pricing is not confirmed yet, we will announcethis point separately later.
This official version is released [b]only for Windows[/b]. We sincerely ask for your understanding since the number of MacOS users is relatively lower than that of Windows users, and we worried about that the dev capacity would lack if we had implementedr parallel development for both operating systems. However, we want to say that [b]MacOS development DOES NOT cease[/b] and are still reviewing ways to efficient 'parallel dev' and optimal update period. We will announce this one later, too.

We hope that you will enjoy our new official version. Thanks.

notes.title: Major large-scale AvaKit update is coming!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/94cefceb2b3b133130f7635b2a1f3dae8f12f5b5.png[/img]
Hello! This is AvaKit devs. First greeting in 2024!
First of all, we apologize for the late announcement. We've not uploaded any news after Halloween.
However, we are consistently doing our best to develop and improve the AvaKit. Several chronical bugs were fixed and the test with VTubers from Korea and Japan was implemented for update. 🧪

[h3][b]And now, we are announcing some significant news.[/b][/h3]

[h1]AvaKit, what have you been doing? 😣[/h1]
Prototype of AvaKit was inevitably unstable.
However, the improvement of this unstableness was consistently postponed since we want to grasp what features need to be added and improved in relatively short time. This leads to the accumulation of bugs and small issues and it is internally concluded that AvaKit must be changed from head to toe to provide the best app that we've imagined.

[h3]SO THIS UPDATE STARTS[/h3]
The update details are as follows.
[list]
[*] Design, color, UI
[*] Improved tracking performance
[*] More kawaii effects and stickers
[*] Camera device searching algorithm stability improved
[*] Optimization
[*] Miscellaneous fix that only devs will know
[*] [h2][b]AND... OUR NEW MASCOT, HARU! 🎉[/b][/h2]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/9ca35c81919273449e5032135ed4ca5b7505284d.png[/img]

[h1]How will the new AvaKit be? 🤔[/h1]
These features will not be applied immediately.
[list]
[*] Smoother and more realistic movement
[*] Integration with streaming platforms (Twitch, YouTube, etc.)
[*] Shader and rendering improvement
[*] Unlimited tracking with just a single camera
[*] ... and many more secret contents that will flourish your livestreaming
[/list]
And after finishing the early access, AvaKit will be officially released and it will not be free.
This is an inevitable decision since we want to sustain the AvaKit dev team and develop amazing new features for the wonderful creators here 🙇‍♂️
The precise pricing plan is not decided yet, so we will announce it ASAP whenver it is confirmed.

[h1]Release Plan[/h1]
Based on our rough sketch, the official first version is going to be released in Jan or Feb this year.
We will announce you the accurate date whenver it is confirmed.

[h3]+ Will AvaKit support MacOS officially?[/h3]
We realize that the MacOS support during the early access was ceased at some point since the number of devs in AvaKit team was limited. Whether MacOS will be officially supported will be confirmed after the official release. This is because there are relatively only a few people who use the MacOS version while there are lots of differences in the dev process between MacOS and Windows. (In terms of development, the code structure is little different and the extra process named 'notarization' must be implemented for MacOS version.) [b]Hence, AvaKit dev thought that the development of amazing new features and communication between all of you will be postponed if we decide to support both operation systems. [/b]
However, [b]MacOS support will not be ceased immediately.[/b] AvaKit team will analyze the proportion of MacOS users and Windows users and will decide the MacOS version update period.


We'll always try our best to improve AvaKit. Thank you.

notes.notes:

AvaKit becomes better after couple of holidays. Also, new features are on development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/e82b5d9e500f67edc3da72f98d9c98eb6a56cdfb.png[/img]
[h2][b]Precise settings for automatic eye blink[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/c5db00000cc110461d1e25078f0901077142f982.png[/img]
[h3]Interval for eye blinking[/h3]
'Interval' is the average time gap for automatic blinking, and the unit is 'second'.
To implement natural movement, 'average' concept (normal distribution) is applied. (For example, if the interval is set '4', then your model might blink randomly once every 3 or 5 seconds.)

[h3]Blink Twice[/h3]
'Blink twice' literally means double-blinking.
We added this feature because people do not always blink exactly once when they blink in real.
The unit is percent(%), which means that your model will always blink once when it is set '0' while your model will always blink twice when it is set '100'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/6bda95603ba2d98265daf6e75eac0fd5a65f3d66.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/6585df6e272c8bc775c7d0c46fbbe445eec12dbe.png[/img]
[h2][b]HANA Tool applicability[/b][/h2]
[url=https://booth.pm/ja/items/2604269]HANA Tool[/url] is the tool developed by [url=https://kuniyan.booth.pm/]くに屋[/url] which is used to control blendshape data.
It is often used to apply perfect sync for VRoid model and it is officially checked that the blendshapes for perfect sync with HANA Tool can be played in AvaKit without any issues.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/a72d3bdc561ba1876cb0d237346062120962b47b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The issue that some models cannot be imported in AvaKit is resolved.
[*] The height-related issue that occurs with some models is resolved.
[/list]

We'll always try our best to improve AvaKit. Thank you.

notes.title: AvaKit v1.1.7 Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]For now, only Windows can be updated.[/b][/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2363370/view/3671048540134058686]The reason why only Windows is available is written here.[/url]

AvaKit update week has come with interesting new features!
Your feedbacks are really helpful to develop better AvaKit 🙇‍♂️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/e82b5d9e500f67edc3da72f98d9c98eb6a56cdfb.png[/img]
[h2]Upgraded VMC protocol[/h2]
Currently, three ways of tracking are available in AvaKit - webcam tracking, perfect sync using iFacialMocap, and VMC protocol.
There are couple of demands related to the precision of VMC protocol, and this update includes the improvement of entire VMC protocol configuration.

Previously, motion data of lower torso from VMC protocol cannot be received since it is worried that it can deter the stability of AvaKit. However, these data are receivable from v1.1.7, which means that[b] the whole body motion data from VMC protocol can be sent [/b]to AvaKit. Also, you can select which motion data of specific body parts from head to both legs will be received from v1.1.7, which provides more various options for AvaKit users.

[h3]Compatibility with VRM Posing Desktop[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895630/VRM_Posing_Desktop][b]VRM Posing Desktop[/b][/url], which is used to implement simple animation or to create precise posing for thumbnails is now compatible with AvaKit. This can be implemented through VMC protocol.

For example, after you strike the pose in VRM Posing Desktop like below,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/5b1d2de7f3b13de6581d164cd71f22dbf50246bc.png[/img]
then choose the tracking method as 'VMC protocol' to receive the data. The result can be shown as follows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/1b6c5e9556af21f545db2a589946e212c67fa100.png[/img]
Like mentioned above, only motion data of partial body part like legs or head is also available. (But, please note that the data already received cannot be reset even if you disable the part.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/fd1827c8155182233ce0895a54da568ece8c30ab.png[/img]
The demo video is below.

[previewyoutube=Rd7qD2hKaXA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Mouth tracking sensitivity added[/h2]
You can define the sensitivity of camera-based mouth tracking from 0 to 50 from v1.1.7.
The higher the sensitivity is, the more dramatic that the mouth of 3D avatar model will be moved.

[previewyoutube=QwH5ur1CpfE;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/6585df6e272c8bc775c7d0c46fbbe445eec12dbe.png[/img]
[h2]Rendering resource optimization[/h2]
We discovered the process that the rendering resource is unneccessarily wasted. Hence, the optimization for the process is implemented in this update.


We'll always try our best to improve AvaKit. Thank you.


[url=https://twitter.com/AvaKit_EN][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/b22c8f31dbd6bc915906c9722dac400324685d29.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/e8qGrZA3CT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/b7437995b02ecc0e033e7a84ea8c9a02413d51c1.png[/img][/url]

This week is AvaKit update week!
Several new features are updated, usability and stability are improved, and couple of bugs are fixed.
Thanks for waiting!
Your feedbacks are really helpful to develop better AvaKit 🙇‍♂️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/e82b5d9e500f67edc3da72f98d9c98eb6a56cdfb.png[/img]
[h2][b]Default shader changed🎉[/b][/h2]
AvaKit tried to introduce lilToon shader as a default, but we realized that there are lots of things to consider than we'd thought. So we applied other type of shader(RealToon), and this causes several issues related to rendering.
AvaKit devs have resolved related issues consistently, while trying to introduce lilToon shader to resolve the fundamental causes and [b]the introduction of lilToon shader is now available from v1.1.6[/b]! Especially, [b]much more optimized shader application is available if you apply lilToon to '.avakitVRM' using AvaKit SDK.[/b]
[i](Also, this one will be used in huge-scale new feature update in the future.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/ab5cec811250dcce1934556db7239ff2750370d1.png[/img]

[h2][b]Pelvis fix[/b][/h2]
We've received couple of feedback saying that the upper torso of the model shakes too drastically compared to other software and it causes 'un-natural' atmosphere.
Through 'Fix Avatar Pelvis' feature, now this phonomenon can be constricted.
You can check this feature at [Tracklng] menu at the left menu bar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/bb1829f902789bfc72a03a392d73fcd8556f6195.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/6585df6e272c8bc775c7d0c46fbbe445eec12dbe.png[/img]

Your feedbacks are really helpful to develop better AvaKit 🙇‍♂️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/6585df6e272c8bc775c7d0c46fbbe445eec12dbe.png[/img]
[h2][b]vsfavatar rendering improved[/b][/h2]
There were some reports that certain vsfavatars cannot be imported. In addition, the texture expression of some vsfavatars was weird. These points are going to be resolved step-by-step.
[i]The texture and material expression of some vsfavatars can still be weird.[/i]

[h2]iFacialMocap stabilization[/h2]
If the absurd data which may lead to severe tracking glitch are received from iFacialMocap, AvaKit can now ignore those kind of data to stabilize the overall tracking performance.

[h2]Slider component improvement[/h2]
Slider component is used when adjusting the transition time for shape key, advanced tracking parameter, and filter-related parameters. We detected there were some factors that can deter the usability and implemented improvement,


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/a72d3bdc561ba1876cb0d237346062120962b47b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Abnormally long loading time and icons missing when the camera is not detected are resolved.
[*] VRM import malfunction depending on the height of VRM model is resolved.
[/list]

[h1](Extra) Why only Windows available? [/h1]
Recently, AvaKit has been unable to support update for MacOS users after v1.1.3. AvaKit needs to request several permissions to start tracking through connected camera and lip-sync tracking. Due to security policy of Apple, [b]only notarized apps can request the permission, and AvaKit has also got notarization by paying some amount of fees to Apple.[/b]
However, this notarization cannot be received after Apple changed its policy. AvaKit devs have been trying to get notarization for AvaKit in various ways from then to support MacOS users ASAP.

We'll always try our best to improve AvaKit. Thank you.

notes.title: AvaKit v1.1.4 Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]For now, only Windows can be updated.[/b][/h3]

As we wrote at the previous notification - '[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2363370/announcements/detail/3676674869983495320]Notification about later updates[/url]', this update is focused on the introduction of [b]AvaKit SDK[/b] that makes it possible to apply various shaders to your VRM, and resolving the issues related to detecting the camera device for tracking.

This is our first fortnight update and it feels for us longer that it really is. Thanks for waiting.
Your feedbacks are really helpful to develop better AvaKit 🙇‍♂️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/e82b5d9e500f67edc3da72f98d9c98eb6a56cdfb.png[/img]
[h2][b]AvaKit SDK[/b][/h2]
You can apply several types of shader that AvaKit SDK is being supported to your VRM model in Unity Editor, and can export it as [b].avakitvrm[/b] format. This .avakitvrm-format file can be directly used in AvaKit. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2363370/view/3674425063126719961]Please click this link for Steam Community post to check the tutorial for installation of AvaKit SDK and the way to export your .avakitvrm file. [/url]

[h3]List of supported shaders in AvaKit SDK[/h3]
[list]
[*] UniUnlit
[*] MToon
[*] URP shader
[*] lilToon
[*] UnlitWF
[*] The type of supported shader will be varied.
[/list]
[h2][i]Import '.vsfavatar' format model (for test) [/i][/h2]
It is incompletely available to import your .vsfavatar model.
However, it is an [b]experimental[/b] feature, and whole import would not be possible for some models.
Please regard it as an intermediate step to develop the complete support of .vsfavatar model or to discover the alternatives.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/6585df6e272c8bc775c7d0c46fbbe445eec12dbe.png[/img]
[h2][b]Improvement of camera device detection[/b][/h2]
There have been several reports about camera detection malfunction from couple of VTuber users. By improving the algorithm related to detecting the camera device, this issue can be resolved from v1.1.4. Also, if the camera is disconnected or the accidental issue occurs at the tracking algorithm, the popup-window will be floated to notify the issue.

[h3]🛠 List of virtual cameras that cannot be detected in v.1.1.4[/h3]
[list]
[*] Twitch Virtual Cam
[*] FaceRig Virtual Camera
[/list]
[h3]🛠 Other notifications[/h3]
It is more available to occur some unexpected crash or issues if you use MacOS device and connect lots of virtual cameras and webcams. Please note this point.

[h2][b]Options for tracking performance (resolution, fps)[/b][/h2]
From v1,1,4, users must set the camera configuration before start tracking in AvaKit. You can choose various options related to tracking performance in the camera setting. You can implement lighter but normal-quality tracking by lowering the resolution and fps, while you can implement heavier but high-quality tracking by heightning the resolution and fps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/eab1a7a06747fa0d1a4c138ddaae3ba9a5613821.png[/img]

[h3][b]🚧 Cautions![/b][/h3]
The 'resolution' in camera setting is NOT the resolution of your display or the maximum supported resolution of your camera, [b]but the resolution of the video that is being captured by your camera[/b]. It regulates the 'size' of the video data.

[b]Higher resolution and frame[/b]
[list]
[*] Better tracking performance
[*] Glitch or latency may occur unless the specification of CPU/GPU is enough
[*] Heavier CPU/GPU usage
[/list]
[b]Lower resolution and frame[/b]
[list]
[*] Lighter CPU/GPU usage
[*] Tracking available even if you are using a common, light CPU/GPU
[*] Relatively worse tracking performance
[/list]
In addition, you can experience glitch or latency if you use 'MJPEG' format since its default frame rate is relatively high (30). - Higher fps means that the size of the data that should be computed is heavy which leads to high volume of computation. It is recommended to use 'YuY2' format if the performance is not satisfactory. [b]Lastly, there often occurs the error when the resolution is set as 'XRGB'.[/b] If the error occurs, please try other resolution options.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/a72d3bdc561ba1876cb0d237346062120962b47b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Issue related to camera device connection (socket) is urgently resolved.[/b]
[*] It is avilable to scroll down the decriptoin box of in-game user report.
[*] Rendering quality of some models is improved. (e.g. Maki)
[/list]

As I said before, the next update patch will be focused on 'debugging'.
We will come back with 'better and more usable' AvaKit by resolving issues to the fullest extent.

We'll always try our best to improve AvaKit. Thank you.

notes.title: AvaKit v1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
We executed middle-scale update based on your feedbacks for v1.0.6-alpha.
The performance of iFacialMocap-based perfect sync that was introduced in the previous version and overall tracking of AvaKit is dramatically improved - minimized tracking issues such as strange movement and instant wiggling.
Your feedbacks are really helpful to develop better AvaKit 🙇‍♂️

[h2]New features[/h2]
[h3]Support expansion for iFacialMocap-based perfect sync[/h3]
In the previous version, all 52 blendshapes should be prepared to start perfect sync in AvaKit, but now you can use iPhone-based facial tracking [b]even if not all of the blendshapes are prepared[/b]. (But, we recommend to prepare all of them to implement it smoothly.)

[h2]Improved features [/h2]
[h3][b]Dramatic improvement[/b] for tracking performance[/h3]
[olist]
[*] VRM over-bending issue is improved when you rotate or tilt down yourself.

[previewyoutube=gjiZYwLj3p8;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=i93iv68d1-w;full][/previewyoutube]
[/olist]
[h3]Improved iFacialMocap-based tracking[/h3]
Motion latency when iPhone-based tracking is implemented for several hours is solved by optimizing the internal cache management structure.

[h3]Outline mask applied[/h3]
Now, outline mask is automatically applied when your VRM has his/her own outline mask.

[h3]Improved texture rendering[/h3]
Sticker texture penetration by VRM when attaching sticker to your VRM is improved.

[h3] Unlimited hot key registration [/h3]
Now, the number of hot key that can be registered is unlimited. (Previously, it was 5.)

We'll always try our best to improve AvaKit. Thank you.

notes.title: AvaKit v1.0.6 - α(alpha) Update
notes.notes:
This v1.0.6-alpha is for testing new features - PERFECT SYNC.
We know that lots of VTubers are using iPhone-based advanced facial tracking with iFacialMoCap, so we integrate that pipeline with our own unique hand tracking so that conventional 3DVTubers can use those features simultaneously.
Your feedbacks are really helpful to develop better AvaKit 🙇‍♂️

[h2]New features[/h2]
[h3]Perfect sync test by integrating AvaKit with iFacialMoCap app[/h3]
Please import your VRM model that perfect sync feature is available. (Rua-chan does not support perfect sync.) Then, turn the iFacialMoCap app on through your iPhone and write the IP address shown in the iFacialMoCap app at the IP address box of AvaKit. (You can check this box at the [Tracking] menu - iFacialMocap section.) Please check whether perfect sync with hand tracking is available in AvaKit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/2c28b1f69c04ebae8863ed60280c63844772887b.png[/img]

[h2]How to use & Cautions[/h2]
[h3]How to use[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Click the [Network & internet] by entering Windows Settings.
[*] Enter your connected network's 'properties' menu.
[*] Set its network profile type as [Private].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/c176a3ac97fb1302bb14543c07fa128fd93e6e5f.png[/img]
[*] If there are any problems or issues, please contact [url=https://twitter.com/AvaKit_EN]AvaKit official Twitter account[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/e8qGrZA3CT]AvaKit official Discord Server[/url].
[/olist]
[h3]Cautions[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Your iPhone for iFacialMocap and your computer for AvaKit must be [b]connected with the SAME network.[/b] (e.g., same wi-fi)
[*] This feature is supported for only [b]VRM models with entire 52 blendshapes[/b] for perfect sync.
[*] If your internet network is bad, the tracking performance also can be bad.
[/olist]

We'll always try our best to improve AvaKit. Thank you.

notes.title: AvaKit 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
AvaKit 1.0.0 version (initial version) has a problem that it spends too much time to discover the connected webcam device, or even cannot find the device. Also, the camera name shown at the display is just 'camera 1', 'camera 2', and so on, instead of its camera name even after it finds the device, which makes it harder for users to decide which camera device to choose.

This issue was related to the way of discovering the USB device, and this update patch can drastically reduce the time to discover your device. After several tests, the average time spent is about 5 to 10 seconds, and the max time spent was about 2 minutes. Also, the device name can be shown intuitively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/5690fac80bc65dd6d738ba99649cc870e0730c47.png[/img]

Also, there was a shortkey-related issue - The virtual keyboard when assigining the shortcut is colored when it is assigned and it goes to initial state when it is unassigned, but the virtual keyboard did not go to initial state even after it is unassigned. This bug is fixed. 

Please feel free to say about issues that you faced or suggestion that you think of to us at the AvaKit Official Discord Server. We are looking forward to seeing you!
